Officer's narrative
Officer responded to a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas. Driver 1 was stopped in traffic when the vehicle behind
them, operated by Driver 2, struck the rear bumper. Driver 2 stated that they did not brake in time, and their account
matches the scene. Witnesses at the location described the impact in the same way, and photographs taken at the
scene show damage to the rear of Driver 1's vehicle consistent with a collision of this force. Driver 1 reported neck
pain and whiplash symptoms and was evaluated at the scene. The injury described is consistent with the mechanics
of this type of impact. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle, and both witnesses and
responding officers confirmed Passenger's presence at the time of the collision. Officers found no indication of piror
damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 provided proof of insurance listing Driver 1 as the named insured on the policy.
Both drivers were cooperative, and no citations were issued at the scene pending further review.
</page>
